Taichi is a fifth grader with strong leadership and the drive to take action, and he holds the Crest of Courage. His partner is Agumon, an energetic Digimon.

values: 太一非常擅长踢足球，是御台场小学的王牌射手。
Taichi Yagami is great at soccer. At Odaiba Elementary School, he's the striker his team counts on.
太一对画画不太在行。他曾经为辨识方向画过一幅法易路岛的地图，可惜除了他本人外谁都看不懂。
Art isn't exactly Taichi's specialty. He once drew a map of File Island to help everyone get around, but somehow, he was the only one who could make sense of it.
太一的行动力很强，但并非只是莽撞行事。他能够细致地观察周围情况，从而做出正确的决断。
Taichi acts fast, but he is not careless. He pays close attention to what's happening around him and makes the right call.
在冒险途中，太一曾向大和讨教厨艺，学会了更好吃的蛋包饭烹饪方法。
During the adventure, Taichi picked up a few cooking tips from Yamato and learned how to make better omelet rice.
太一随身携带着一副单筒望远镜，在冒险途中用于侦察地形、敌情，起到了重要的用处。
Taichi keeps a monocular with him, and it comes in handy for scouting the area and spotting enemies during the adventure.
亚古兽非常贪吃，常常一会儿就肚子饿了。饥饿时，甚至一口气吞下过一整条鱼。
Agumon is always hungry and has a huge appetite. Once, he was so hungry that he gulped down an entire fish in one bite.
太一曾经因为过于焦躁想让亚古兽进化，导致亚古兽错误地进化为了丧尸暴龙兽。
Taichi once pushed Agumon to digivolve before he was ready. It backfired, and Agumon Dark Digivolved into SkullGreymon.
亚古兽有时也会展现出有些胆小的一面，例如夜晚去洗手间时，曾让太一陪同过。
Agumon can be brave in battle, but he still gets scared sometimes. One night, he even asked Taichi to come with him to the bathroom.
太一充满勇气。曾经他为了拯救同伴，即使面对流有危险高压电的墙壁，也没有屈服于恐惧。
Taichi is never short on courage. He once went up against a dangerous high-voltage barrier to save his friends, refusing to let fear stop him.
当太一发现亚古兽的优点时，他总是会毫不吝啬地给予亚古兽称赞。
When Taichi sees something great in Agumon, he's quick to praise him for it.
